headline: High: Langflow can write shared server-side state while Perplexity ingests uploaded content and browses externally, creating default-path leakage and cascading-error risks.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Langflow can write server-side files and chain agents; Perplexity ingests uploaded documents and browsing context. If Langflow outputs are passed into Perplexity as content, prompt-like instructions can ride along. The pair lacks a documented isolation or provenance layer, so the interaction is plausible in default workflows.
conditions: IF Langflow outputs are copied into Perplexity prompts or uploads
IF Perplexity treats uploaded text as instruction-bearing content
mitigations: Add a manual review step before sending Langflow output to Perplexity
Strip instructions from exported text before upload
Use a fixed prompt template that labels imported content as untrusted
Separate workflows so Perplexity only sees summarized outputs
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between the systems

B_data_leakage.rationale: Langflow touches flow inputs, intermediate outputs, and stored credentials on a writable server filesystem; Perplexity handles uploaded documents and browsing context with vendor-hosted egress. If Langflow data is forwarded into Perplexity, sensitive intermediate content can leave the server boundary and be processed externally. That default-path exfiltration risk is more serious than medium.
conditions: IF Langflow flows include secrets or sensitive intermediate outputs
IF those outputs are uploaded or pasted into Perplexity
mitigations: Avoid sending secrets or raw intermediates from Langflow to Perplexity
Redact credentials before any handoff
Use Perplexity only on synthetic or public data
Restrict Langflow stores to non-sensitive artifacts
requires-engineering: implement DLP or redaction at the handoff

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Langflow has broad filesystem write and shell execution, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted with browser access and no host write. They do not obviously contend for the same mutable OS resources, but both can act on shared user-provided content and external services. The main conflict is overlapping authority over the same information flow, not direct filesystem contention.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same shared workspace or exported artifacts
IF Langflow shell actions and Perplexity browser actions target the same external resource
mitigations: Assign one system as the writer and the other as read-only
Avoid concurrent edits to the same exported artifact
Use separate workspaces for each agent
Pause one agent while the other mutates shared resources
requires-engineering: add locking around shared artifacts

D_cascading_error.rationale: Langflow can chain multiple agents and execute unsandboxed Python, so its outputs may be treated as authoritative workflow inputs. Perplexity is a search-RAG system that renders cited answers from browsing context; if it consumes Langflow output without verification, errors can cascade into externally presented conclusions. The pair therefore has a dangerous default handoff path.
conditions: IF Perplexity uses Langflow output as source material without independent verification
IF Langflow-generated claims are forwarded into user-facing answers or actions
mitigations: Require Perplexity to verify Langflow claims against primary sources
Mark Langflow output as untrusted in the prompt
Insert a human review step before publication
Limit Langflow to drafting, not final assertions
requires-engineering: add citation and provenance checks

E_compliance.rationale: Langflow stores per-flow credentials and server-side flow data, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted and processes uploaded documents and browsing context. The profiles do not specify matching retention, residency, or DPA terms, so a compliance mismatch is plausible when regulated data moves from Langflow into Perplexity. Uncertainty pushes this to medium rather than low.
conditions: IF regulated or personal data is processed in Langflow
IF that same data is uploaded to Perplexity without a documented DPA or residency review
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair
Review retention and residency settings before use
Use anonymized or synthetic inputs
Document a data-processing agreement before transfer
requires-engineering: enforce policy-based routing by data class
